reason: The setup script makes the first step sound less painful, and I like that I can start without a paid search key. I still have to install Docker and figure out which sources cover the roles I want, so I would keep using my current boards unless I could try the workflow first.
objection: I do not want to spend my limited job-search time debugging Docker or discover later that the sources do not cover the countries and roles I need.
would_change_my_mind: A short demo on an ordinary laptop showing the install, a relevant search from my region, and how much memory it uses.
